changes: Speed Limit Assist: any set speed over the limit now works under openpilot longitudinal (alpha long) — the exact 120/130 km/h (70/80 mph) cluster handshake is replaced by a single SET+/SET− press to confirm (same handshake ICBM uses); the cluster set speed is only a ceiling and changing it never deactivates SLA (override with the accelerator or by turning SLA off)

Speed Limit Assist: one-shot prompts — a post-activation tip recommending a 130 km/h / 80 mph ceiling for full range, and a raise-set-speed prompt (limit + margin) when the cluster sits below the limit; never nags, once per episode

Speed Limit Assist: once active, limit changes auto-apply in both directions with only the chime and sign-overlay flash — the SET+/− confirm handshake applies to initial activation only; the 130 km/h ceiling tip shows once per drive

MICI: longitudinal target debug HUD above the steering wheel — plan target speed, planned vs applied accel, and up to 3 limiter tags over a rolling 4 s window ranked by contribution (dwell + braking demand), biggest culprit first with the speed limit pinned last as the nominal limiter (CRUISE/SLA/CURVE/MAP/LEAD/MODEL/CLIP/STOP/FDEC, published as longitudinalPlanSP.primaryLimiter); toggle via Longitudinal > Longitudinal Target HUD (BPLongitudinalTargetHUD)

DEC now publishes WHY blended (model) mode is selected — trajectory-endpoint slow-down (with 0-1 urgency), standstill hold, or FCW — as longitudinalPlanSP.dec.blendedReason/urgency; the longitudinal target HUD suffixes the MODEL tag (MODEL·SLOW / MODEL·STILL / MODEL·FCW) and shows the urgency during slow-downs

Model Decel Gate (Longitudinal > toggle, BPModelDecelGate): in Experimental Mode the driving model may only slow the car — engages instantly on decel intent (model accel, collapsed plan-end speed, or stop hold) so early smooth braking for lights and stopped leads is preserved, while ACC owns acceleration and cruise so the model can no longer hold the car below the set speed or speed limit; jerk-limited hand-off, publishes longitudinalPlanSP.modelDecelGateActive, takes precedence over Dynamic Experimental Control

ICBM under alpha long: walks the physical cluster set speed to the confirmed speed limit plus a configurable margin (new 'Alpha Long ICBM Set Speed Margin' setting, default +5 km/h/mph, vehicle dependent) so the vehicle's cruise module never limits acceleration near the target

Speed Limit Assist: fixed alert spam — 'adjusting to speed limit' no longer re-fires when map data flickers over OSM coverage gaps or the resolved source flaps between car and map on the same posted limit
Speed limit adjust notifications are now chime-only (no text banner / dark overlay); the visual is a flashing speed limit sign with underglow for the same duration

MICI: new persistent speed limit sign overlay (MUTCD/Vienna) with curve speed diamond showing the targeted vision/map curve speed; toggle via Visuals > Speed Limit Sign Overlay (BPSpeedLimitSignOverlay)

fixes: Speed limit resolver: map-data staleness guard and upcoming-limit adaptation were dead code (monotonic vs Unix-epoch clock mismatch); stale GPS fixes now invalidate map limits and the car adapts toward a lower limit ahead
Speed limit resolver: the last seen limit no longer latches forever — held 10 s to bridge OSM coverage gaps, then released so a stale limit cannot cap the car indefinitely
Speed Limit Assist: no more capping to an unconfirmed limit during the preActive window; 'inactive' state is recoverable (new limit re-arms the handshake) instead of a dead end until re-engagement

Speed Limit Assist: during a re-confirm window the car keeps capping at the previously confirmed limit, and losing the limit (tunnels, OSM gaps) exits to pending with a chime instead of silently accelerating toward the cluster ceiling
